subject: Next-step: ML/infra runthrough (60-90min) — calendar lock & attendee asks
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Kate Liu <kate@olivehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-01T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up + propose ML/infra runthrough (60-90m)

Hi Kate — thanks again for a great discovery call this morning. Quick recap: Olive Health is evaluating a low-latency inference path for patient-side classification and wants predictable cost/throughput. We covered workload shape, compliance needs, and the preliminary SLA targets.

Next step: schedule a focused ML/infra runthrough (60–90 minutes) where our ML infra leads walk through serving architecture, latency/cost tradeoffs, quantization options, and the integration checklist. Goal is to surface any blockers and agree on a mutual action plan.

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue 2028-04-11 14:00–15:30 (90m)
- Wed 2028-04-12 10:00–11:00 (60m)
- Thu 2028-04-13 13:00–14:30 (90m)

Could you confirm which of these works and who from your side will join (primary ML engineer, infra/SRE, security/compliance)? We’ve attached a short mutual action plan and a precall checklist (attachment stubs) — please add any extra items you want covered.

High-level agenda we intend to cover:
1) 10m — goals & success criteria
2) 30–50m — architecture walkthrough + perf expectations
3) 15–25m — data/ops/security constraints and onboarding checklist
4) 10–20m — next steps & mutual action items

Ask: please share attendee names + timezone, and if you can upload a small sample of the dataset (anonymized) or a tokenization/profile so we can size the test runs.

Thanks — I’ll hold the first slot tentatively until I hear back.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com
(attachment: Olive_Health_Mutual_Action_Plan_v2.pdf (PDF))
(attachment: mlrun-precall-checklist.md (MD))

From: Kate Liu <kate@olivehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-02T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + propose ML/infra runthrough (60-90m)

Jonas — thanks, this looks good. Appreciate the clear agenda. A few notes from our side:
- Preferred week: Apr 11–13, Wed afternoon or Thu early afternoon are best for the team.
- Attendees: Pat Smith (Head of ML), Sam Torres (Platform/Infra), myself (Product). We may pull in Lydia (security) if you plan to deep-dive retention and access controls.
- Data: we can upload a small anonymized sample to the Drive link you shared; expect that by EOD Tue.

One ask up front — can you confirm whether Redwood supports customer-managed KMS for key material and whether you have an SOC2 Type II report available? That will determine who we need on the call.

If Wed 4/12 at 14:00–15:30 PDT is available on your side, that would be ideal. Otherwise Thu 4/13 13:00 PDT also works.

Thanks,
Kate
Kate Liu
Director, Product
Olive Health
(kate@olivehealth.com)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Kate Liu <kate@olivehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + propose ML/infra runthrough (60-90m)

Kate — perfect, thanks for the quick reply. Wed 2028-04-12 14:00–15:30 PDT works for us; I’ve tentatively reserved that slot.

Short answers to your pre-asks:
- KMS: yes, Redwood Private can be configured with customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) — we’ll have Marissa provide the KMS integration checklist on the call.
- SOC2: we can share our SOC 2 Type II report under NDA; Marissa can circulate the artifact before the runthrough.

Marissa / Ben — can you confirm internal attendees? Recommended: our ML infra lead (architecture + perf), an SRE who owns deployment/observability (Ben), and Marissa for compliance/KMS + customer security questions. Also calling out that we should prepare a short pre-read: performance profiles for the candidate model, quantization tradeoffs, and a sample mutual action plan.

Kate — I’ll send a calendar invite and include a pre-read folder. Any constraints on recording/notes? We can keep the session internal-only or mark recording off if you prefer.

Jonas

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Kate Liu <kate@olivehealth.com>
Date: 2028-04-02T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + propose ML/infra runthrough (60-90m)

Looping in quickly — I’ll join and bring our infra lead (Sofia) and a compliance SME. Ben — can you take the SRE slot and prep the observability/runbook section? Suggested additions to agenda: fallback/failover policy, data retention limits, and a deployment rollout checklist.

I’ll upload the SOC2 redline and the KMS integration checklist to the Drive folder before the call. Also recommend we request a small model manifest from Olive (model size, tokenizer, expected max sequence) so the runtime team can pre-configure kernel/quantization suggestions.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference

From: Kate Liu <kate@olivehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>

Thanks all — Wed 4/12 14:00–15:30 PDT locked for Olive Health attendees (Pat, Sam, Lydia (security tentative)). We uploaded the anonymized sample + model manifest to the Drive folder (files: olive_sample_1000.jsonl, model_manifest_v1.yaml).

Recording: we prefer not to record — notes only.

I confirmed our procurement contact (procurement@olivehealth.com) will be on standby for any pricing/contract clarifications after the technical session. Looking forward to the runthrough.

Kate
